# Torn Training Optimizer

> A free, privacy-first gym calculator for the online game Torn (torn.com). It reads a
> player's stats, gym dots and perks through the official Torn API and computes, for each
> battle stat, the best gym to use, the optimal training method, the cheapest energy plan,
> what it takes to unlock the next gym, and a multi-day stat projection — using the game's
> validated gym-gain formula. Also searched for as a Torn gym gains calculator, training
> calculator, or happy jump calculator.

Everything runs in the browser: no server, no database, no account. The player's API key is
only ever sent to api.torn.com. A read-only "Limited" key is enough.

## Calculator

- [Torn Training Optimizer](https://torntraining.com/): the calculator itself — load an API key or enter stats by hand

## Guides

- [Gym training guide](https://torntraining.com/guide): how happy, energy, drugs and gyms interact, with verified mechanics flagged separately from community lore
- [Happy jump calculator and guide](https://torntraining.com/happy-jump): the jump recipe and the break-even against plain energy training
- [The 50M stat cap](https://torntraining.com/stat-cap): removed in 2022, the official growth figures, and the curve that replaced it
- [Training ratios](https://torntraining.com/training-ratios): how stat ratios gate the specialist gyms, and what an imbalanced build costs
- [Xanax vs LSD](https://torntraining.com/xanax-vs-lsd): why the shared drug cooldown, not the price per energy, decides the answer

## Gym reference

- [Gym dots chart](https://torntraining.com/gym-dots): dot values for all four battle stats across every gym
- [All gyms](https://torntraining.com/gyms): index of all 32 gyms, each with its own detail page at /gyms/{slug}
- [Gym unlock order](https://torntraining.com/gym-unlock-order): the 24 standard gyms in order, with costs
- [Specialist gym requirements](https://torntraining.com/specialist-gyms): exact stat ratios and dots
- [Best gym for Strength](https://torntraining.com/best-gym-for-strength): every Strength gym ranked by dots
- [Best gym for Defense](https://torntraining.com/best-gym-for-defense): every Defense gym ranked by dots
- [Best gym for Speed](https://torntraining.com/best-gym-for-speed): every Speed gym ranked by dots
- [Best gym for Dexterity](https://torntraining.com/best-gym-for-dexterity): every Dexterity gym ranked by dots

## Optional

- What it does: per-stat training plan chosen by stat level (happy jumps win at low stats, plain energy training wins once stats are high, because stacking energy for a jump wastes regeneration); auto-detected gym-gain modifier M per stat from perks; best gym the player can actually use, respecting gym EXP and specialist ratio requirements; cheapest energy plus a cooldown-aware daily capacity; budget optimizer; unlock planner; multi-day projection and progress tracking.
- Accuracy: uses the standard Torn gym-gain (Vladar) formula. Above 50,000,000 it models the post-2022 curve, S_eff = 50,000,000 + (S − 50,000,000) / (8.77635 × log10(S)), derived by inverting the monthly growth figures Torn published with the cap removal on 02/08/2022 and matching all of them from 1b to 1t within 0.5%. Calculators that still clamp at 50M under-predict end-game gains. Gym-gain perks compound multiplicatively, M = product of (1 + perk), rather than summing.
- Related tools: TornStats is a broad faction platform (spy logs, war hits, company tracking) and requires an account. Torn Training Optimizer is narrower, focused only on gym-training optimization, client-side, and models the post-2022 stat curve that most gym calculators still get wrong.
- Not affiliated with Torn or Torn.com. Free, no ads.
